# How a RiFRA kitchen is made — 3D factory

Animated, interactive 3D reconstruction of the **RiFRA** kitchen factory in Gerno di Lesmo (Italy). You walk through the production steps of a kitchen, among machines, departments and people at work.

**All the graphics are generated by code**: no downloaded 3D models and no photos used as textures. The building, machinery, materials and people are built and animated in three.js.

> Conceived and developed by **Marco Radice** for Luxury Academy, with Claude Code.
> This is a **public portfolio copy**: the commit history, internal working notes and client material (saved website pages, staff photos) have been removed.

## The three parts

1. **Interactive 3D page** (three.js r186) — the main deliverable. It ships as **a single HTML file that works offline**, in Italian and English:
   - `come-nasce-una-cucina-rifra-3d.html`
   - `come-nasce-una-cucina-rifra-3d-en.html`

   It also has a trade-fair kiosk mode (`?kiosk=1`) and a video mode (`?video=1`).
2. **Blender version and video spot** — the scene is exported from the page and rendered photorealistically in Blender with Python (`bpy`) scripts run from the command line. The result is a 50-second spot with motion graphics.
3. **2D isometric version** (`come-nasce-una-cucina-rifra.html`) — the first version, kept as a fallback for devices without WebGL.

## Try it

Open `come-nasce-una-cucina-rifra-3d-en.html` in a browser: it is self-contained.

## Technical highlights

- **Procedural** textures and materials.
- Automated **collision checks** between people and machines.
- **Performance budget**: 60 fps and at most 250 draw calls at 1080p.
- Offline build that inlines everything into one file (about 1.3 MB per language) and verifies there are no network requests.
- Modular Blender pipeline: import, animation, realism, people, touch-ups, spot direction, rendering and editing.
- Machine layout and production facts documented with sources in `ricerca/`.

## Structure

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `3d/index.html`, `3d/js/` | 3D page source: scene, building, machines, departments, people, materials |
| `build/tools/` | single-file offline build, video recording, automated checks, export to Blender |
| `blender/` | Blender pipeline and spot |
| `ricerca/` | facts with sources, machine layout, technical reports |
| `DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` | brand colours, fonts and components |

## Local development

Requirements: Node.js 20+, Python 3. The spot also needs Blender 5.2 LTS and ffmpeg.

```bash
cd build/tools && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
cd ../.. && python3 -m http.server 8767 --bind 127.0.0.1
# open http://127.0.0.1:8767/3d/index.html
```

To rebuild the single offline files: `cd build/tools && node build3d.mjs`.
